title: Reason-guided Human Reward Modeling for Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies optimized for task rewards may produce behaviors that are efficient but misaligned with human expectations, safety preferences, or intent. This paper presents a reason-guided preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) framework that learns a human reward model from trajectory-level feedback. In addition to preference labels, the framework incorporates reason tags explaining why a behavior is preferred, enabling the learned reward to capture both human choices and their underlying rationale. Compared with preference-only reward learning, the reason-guided formulation provides additional supervision for learning human-aligned rewards and improves the interpretability of the resulting policy. The learned human reward is combined with the environment reward during policy optimization, allowing the agent to improve task performance while producing more interpretable, human- aligned, and preference-se

translated_title: 面向偏好强化学习的推理引导式人类奖励建模
translated_abstract: 针对任务奖励进行优化的强化学习（RL）策略可能产生高效但与人类期望、安全偏好或意图不一致的行为。本文提出了一种推理引导的基于偏好的强化学习框架，该框架从轨迹级反馈中学习人类奖励模型。除了偏好标签之外，该框架还融入了解释行为为何被偏好的理由标签，使学习到的奖励能够同时捕捉人类的选择及其背后的根本原因。与仅使用偏好标签的奖励学习相比，推理引导的表述方式为学习与人类对齐的奖励提供了额外的监督信号，并提高了最终策略的可解释性。学习到的人类奖励在策略优化过程中与环境奖励相结合，使智能体能够在提高任务性能的同时，产生更可解释、与人类对齐且符合偏好的行为。
tldr: 本文提出一种推理引导的偏好强化学习框架，通过在偏好标签之外融入解释偏好理由的理由标签来学习人类奖励模型，使奖励同时捕捉人类选择及其背后的原因，从而提升策略与人类偏好的对齐程度和可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reason-guided preference-based reinforcement learning framework that incorporates reason tags explaining preference rationale alongside preference labels to learn a human reward model, enabling rewards to capture both human choices and their underlying reasons, thereby improving human alignment and policy interpretability.
